name: @haste-health/meta-value
description: Haste Health Meta Value library for TypeScript. Wraps values in FHIR metadata.

scripts._generate_meta: pnpm node ../cli/lib/hastehealth.js generate meta --output src/v2/generated/meta/r4.ts && pnpm node ../cli/lib/hastehealth.js generate meta --version 4.3 --output src/v2/generated/meta/r4b.ts
scripts._generate_type_canonical: pnpm node ../cli/lib/hastehealth.js generate type-to-canonical --output src/v2/generated/type-canonical/r4.ts && pnpm node ../cli/lib/hastehealth.js generate type-to-canonical --version 4.3 --output src/v2/generated/type-canonical/r4b.ts

author: haste-health
